posts.name: Honolulu Blue
posts.cooked:
The last challenge for the Dark Watch team was its most extended.  Skinwalker Gloomweaver faced them at the Realm of Discord.  Gloomy was up to his usual tricks, which were partially countered by the gang.  Once he went into self-destruct mode, our heroes started to fall.  First Mr. Fixer, then Expatriette, and finally Visionary.  Nightmist, with a combination of timely heals, deflections, and cocoons, never got below 18 HP.  Gloomweaver approrpriately had the final blow by his own hand.  This version scores out at +27, by the way, and it took two tries for me to win this.

I'd like to thank everyone for reading.  Now it's time for me to move on to different challenges.

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
As someone with a three syllable name with a common "nickname", this is a pet peeve of mine.  You won't believe how many times I've introduced myself as Jonathan, only to be met with the reply "Hi Jon*!"   Excuse me, but if I wanted you to call me Jon, I would have introduced myself that way.  Has it ever crossed your mind that maybe I introduced myself as "Jonathan" because I wanted you to call me that?.

 

I have much less of a problem with politely asking about nicknames, or honest mistakes (like you made), but some of my irritation crosses over (and Christopher's name gets shortened irritatingly frequently), which is why you drew such a snarky correction, rather than a polite one.  I do apologize.

 

 

*Or worse, John.  John and Jonathan are etymologically completely seperate names (From Biblical Yochanan and Yonatan respectively), no matter how similar they sound.
